prompt: Which of the four is not a lever, by the lesson?

choices.text: People, since adding people always makes a project later
choices.why: A lever with a cost; Brooks said later before sooner, not never.

choices.text: Quality
choices.why: Right: moving it is borrowing in secret, and the bill arrives later.

choices.text: Time
choices.why: A real lever with a visible cost.

choices.text: Scope, since features are promised to clients in advance
choices.why: Scope is the cheapest lever.

prompt: The estimate was ten weeks and the calendar held eight. How many weeks short was the team?

choices.text: It is against company policy in Q4
choices.why: No such policy.

choices.text: Newcomers slow it down first
choices.why: Right: it makes a late project later before it makes it sooner, because newcomers need the time of the people already on it.

choices.text: More people means lower quality by definition, whatever the task
choices.why: Not the argument.

choices.text: Other teams never lend their engineers
choices.why: They sometimes do; it costs their own work.

prompt: Who owns which part of the trade, by the lesson?

choices.text: The client, Boa Praça, sets all four
choices.why: Boa Praça has a need; Marola decides how to meet it.
